data_sources.name: OpenStreetMap Nominatim
data_sources.what_it_provides: Reverse and forward geocoding: coordinates to street name, postcode and area
data_sources.notes: Free tier, rate-limited to 1 request/second, real-time lookup, not a static dataset

data_sources.name: Southampton fly-tipping and waste statistics
data_sources.what_it_provides: Local evidence of problem scale (10,948 incidents year to March 2024; rising per-1,000-population rate)

data_sources.name: FixMyStreet (Southampton reports)
data_sources.what_it_provides: Reference point for real public reporting volume (755 open fly-tipping cases, Feb 2025); not used as a live data feed

data_sources.name: Wikipedia - Category: Areas of Southampton
data_sources.what_it_provides: Base list of 30 named Southampton areas used for area-matching; Portswood added separately as a known omission

synthetic_data_statement: All resident phone numbers, conversation transcripts, and test report content used during development and demonstration are synthetic and clearly labelled as such. No real personal data was collected, stored, or sent to any AI service at any point.
